verdict.rationale: Orrick's Tech Studio is a web-based self-service tool suite, so asking whether users can opt out of usage tracking is a fair question. The pack does not document a telemetry or analytics opt-out. The note that forms "require functional cookies to load" hints at cookie categories but does not show a user-facing control for declining tracking. "No registration required" concerns account sign-up, not usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
